Title: Warm Bread for the Fields
Summary: Anna's loaves are cooling in Buena Square. Carry three to Farmer Rolf before the midday break.

Objectives.Description: Collect loaves from Anna's cooling rack
Deliver the bread to Farmer Rolf

OfferDialogue: Oh, perfect timing! Rolf's been in the fields since dawn.
Three loaves, straight to him - and don't you dare nibble the crusts on the way.
CompleteDialogue: Rolf said they were still warm? Good. Take some rations for your trouble.

Title: Herbs at the Forest Edge
Summary: The herbalist is running low on healing herbs. They grow thick where the fields meet the trees.

Objectives.Description: Pick healing herbs at the forest edge

OfferDialogue: Six bundles of the broad-leafed ones, please. Not the fuzzy ones - those make you itch for a week.
Stay out of the deep woods. Something's been spooking the deer.
CompleteDialogue: Lovely, fresh and unbruised. Here - one of my own brews, in case the woods bite back.

Title: The Little Wanderer
Summary: Rolf's youngest wandered off chasing dragonflies. Search the river ford before dusk.

Objectives.Description: Search the river ford
Pick up the carved bird charm by the water

OfferDialogue: My boy... he never goes past the fence, but the gate was open.
He loves the river. Please - the ford, before it gets dark.
CompleteDialogue: He was sitting on a rock, crying over his bird charm? Ha... that's my son.
Thank you. Truly. Buena owes you one.

Title: Mending Fences
Summary: Wild boars broke through Rolf's pasture fence. Fetch planks from the village and patch the gaps.

Objectives.Description: Collect fence planks from the village woodpile
Repair the broken fence sections

OfferDialogue: Three gaps, and the cows have noticed every one of them.
Planks are stacked by the woodpile. Hammer's in the shed.
CompleteDialogue: Solid work. The cows look personally offended.

Title: Goblins in the Deep Forest
Summary: A goblin band has made camp in the deep forest and has started raiding snares. Thin their numbers.

Objectives.Description: Defeat goblins in the deep forest

OfferDialogue: E-rank posting: goblins, deep forest, six confirmed at least.
They're weak alone and brave in groups. Watch for thrown rocks.
CompleteDialogue: Six? Clean work. The trappers will be glad. Points logged to your card.

Title: Wolves at the Pasture
Summary: A hungry pack circles Buena's farms at dusk. Hold the livestock pen until the wolves give up.

Objectives.Description: Defend the livestock pen
Drive off the wolves

OfferDialogue: Wolves are testing the pen again. Normally I'd handle it myself, but I'm on patrol duty.
One minute of holding the line and they'll lose their nerve. Don't let them reach the sheep.
CompleteDialogue: Not a single sheep missing. Heh - maybe I should hand you my patrol too.

Title: The Road to Roa
Summary: A merchant's cart is heading to Roa with Buena's harvest. Bandits have been sighted on the road.

Objectives.Description: Escort the merchant's cart to Roa

OfferDialogue: Wheat, cheese and a very nervous mule. That's my whole fortune, friend.
Get me to Roa's gate in one piece and I'll pay in coin, not in cabbages.
CompleteDialogue: Roa! Walls, guards, and not one arrow in my hat. You've earned every copper.

Title: The Pack Leader
Summary: The wolves were driven by an enraged alpha - bigger, faster and smarter than the rest. End it.

Objectives.Description: Defeat the alpha wolf

OfferDialogue: Tracks the size of a dinner plate. That's no ordinary wolf.
It's enraged and quick. Watch the crouch before it pounces - that's your opening.
CompleteDialogue: So the beast is down. The patrols can sleep again. Fine work.

Title: Scales in the Foothills
Summary: A juvenile red wyrm has strayed south from the mountains into the Fittoa foothills. Drive it down before it reaches the farms.

Objectives.Description: Defeat the juvenile red wyrm

OfferDialogue: A red wyrm. Young, thank the gods, but a wyrm all the same.
It rears before it breathes and it takes wing before it dives. Read it, or it reads you.
CompleteDialogue: You brought down a red wyrm. Roa will be talking about this for a year.

Title: Lessons of Chantless Magic
Summary: Paul wants to see what his son's magic can really do before he sends you on to Roa.

Objectives.Description: Talk to Paul at the house
Show Paul your Stone Cannon at the hill tree
Light the old runes around the hill
Travel to Roa's gate as Paul asked

OfferDialogue: Your father's been pacing since breakfast. He says he wants to 'see the magic properly'.
Be gentle with him, dear. His pride bruises easier than his knees.
CompleteDialogue: You made it all the way to Roa? Good. He won't admit it, but your father is very proud of you.

Title: A Letter for the Captain
Summary: Paul has a sealed letter for the guard captain at Roa's gate. Fetch it from his desk and deliver it.

Objectives.Description: Take the sealed letter from Paul's desk
Hand the letter to the guard captain

OfferDialogue: Since you know the road now - this goes to the captain at Roa's gate.
And no reading it. It's boring knight business anyway. Mostly.
CompleteDialogue: Greyrat's seal. Asking for more patrols again, is he? Tell him I'll see what I can spare.

Title: Raid on the Roa Road
Summary: Bandits are hitting carts on the road to Roa. Anyone nearby can answer the call.

Objectives.Description: Defeat the road bandits
Silence the bandit hedge-mages

OfferDialogue: [World Event] Smoke on the Roa road - a caravan is under attack!
CompleteDialogue: [World Event] The road is clear. Merchants will remember who helped.

Title: Goblin Incursion
Summary: Goblins are pouring out of the forest edge toward Buena. Hold the palisade and break the rush.

Objectives.Description: Break the goblin rush
Hold the village palisade

OfferDialogue: [World Event] Bells in Buena! Goblins at the forest edge!
CompleteDialogue: [World Event] The goblins scatter back into the trees. Buena stands.

Title: Mud Brakes
Summary: A cart has broken loose at the top of the village lane and is rolling toward the square. Magic is faster than legs - bog it down.

Objectives.Description: Stop the runaway cart with Quagmire

OfferDialogue: Young master - the cart! It's heading for the square and the children are playing there!
CompleteDialogue: The wheels are sunk to the axle... and nobody hurt. Well done. I will fetch the shovel.

Title: The Old Watchtower
Summary: An old border watchtower stands in ruins north of the river. The guild wants it charted and searched.

Objectives.Description: Discover the watchtower ruins
Search the ruins for patrol records

OfferDialogue: Exploration posting: chart the old watchtower. Nobody's logged it in years.
Bring back anything with writing on it. Maps especially.
CompleteDialogue: An old patrol map? The cartographers will love this. Survey logged.

Title: Supplies for the Greyrat House
Summary: Lilia needs healing herbs for the house medicine chest. Gather them and bring them home.

Objectives.Description: Gather healing herbs
Bring the herbs to Lilia

OfferDialogue: The medicine chest is nearly empty, and the master insists on sparring every morning.
CompleteDialogue: Thank you. These will be put to use sooner than I would like, I suspect.
